description.narrative: Needs Assessment and project objectives: FMO is implementing the Ventures Program (www.fmo.nl/venturesprogram), an investment mechanism of EUR 200 million focusing on tech enabled early-stage companies, with the participation of the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the European Commission. Operating in parallel with the investment portfolio, the Ventures Program Technical Assistance (TA) Facility will focus on developing the maturity of the venture capital industry across many emerging markets (including Africa and the European Neighborhood). Ecosystem building activities will focus on strengthening existing organizations and programs across countries where the Ventures Program will invest, as well as providing guidance and support to the wider community and innovators developing solutions to support early-stage ventures.
